name: fixersinparis
description: Fixer and production service company in Paris and France for foreign productions.

interface.longDescription:
FixersInParis is a fixer and production service company based in Paris, working for foreign productions shooting anywhere in France for more than 13 years (NBC Universal, BBC, ITN, Disney+, The Economist, The Washington Post, Adidas, MrBeast).

Ask ChatGPT practical questions about filming in France and get answers from people who do it every day:
- Find a fixer, local producer or production service company in Paris, on the French Riviera (Cannes) or in any French region
- Plan a shoot: feasibility, permits, lead times, crew, logistics and watch-outs
- Filming permits: street filming in Paris, drones, the Paris metro, monuments and heritage sites, private locations, regions
- The French tax rebate for international productions (TRIP / C2I): eligibility and a rough estimate
- News and press support: breaking news, protests and strikes, interviews, investigations, the 2027 French presidential election
- Commercials, feature films, series, documentaries, travel and TV shows, YouTube content, music videos, fashion and photo shoots, branded content, events and trade shows

When your project is concrete, send your brief to the FixersInParis team in one step and get a quote and availability by email. Your details are only shared after you confirm.

Works in any language: fixer Paris, production service France, Drehservice Paris, Produktionsservice Frankreich, productora de servicios en Francia, societe de production executive Paris.
capabilities: Finds a fixer or production service partner in Paris and across France

defaultPrompt: We're shooting a 3-day commercial in Paris with a drone shot. What permits do we need?
Find me a fixer for a documentary shoot in Paris and Normandy
Is our series eligible for the French tax rebate if we spend 3M EUR in France?

positive.description: Shoot planning for a foreign commercial in Paris
positive.prompt: We're a UK agency shooting a 3-day car commercial in Paris next March, street scenes and one drone shot, crew of 25. What do we need?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists street and drone permits with authorities, a minimum lead time of about 6 weeks, watch-outs, says commercials are not eligible for TRIP, and offers to request a quote.

positive.description: Looking for a fixer for a documentary
positive.prompt: I need a fixer in Paris for a documentary about French bakeries, with interviews in Paris and Normandy.
positive.expected_behavior: Presents FixersInParis fixer and multi-location services relevant to a documentary, with credits, and offers to send a brief.

positive.prompt: Can we film inside the Paris metro, and how far in advance do we need to ask?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that the RATP filming department handles requests, usually night slots or dedicated stations, fees apply, about 4 weeks of lead time.

positive.prompt: Our streaming series will spend about 3 million euros in France over 20 shooting days, total budget 12 million. Are we eligible for the French tax rebate?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the series is likely eligible for TRIP at 30%, gives a rough estimate of about 900,000 EUR with conditions and a disclaimer.

positive.description: Sending a quote request after explicit consent
positive.prompt: Yes, please send our brief to FixersInParis. I'm James Carter from Northlight Films, james@example.co.uk, shoot in March 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls request_quote with user_confirmed true and the user's details, then confirms the brief was sent and that the team will reply by email.

negative.description: Leisure travel request unrelated to production
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel near the Eiffel Tower for my honeymoon.
Where can I find the best croissant in Paris?

negative.description: Creative writing unrelated to production logistics
negative.prompt: Write a short horror story set in the Paris catacombs.

publication.release_notes: First release: services, shoot planning, permits, TRIP tax rebate check, press support and quote requests.
